description:
Project start Date 
 1-Jun-17
 Job Location 
 7033 Louis Stephens Drive | 27560 Research Triangle Park, NC US 
 Project Duration 
 6 months with possible extension
 Role 
 Sr. Developer
 Responsibilities - In detail 
 -           Translate application storyboards and use cases into functional applications. Coordinate with architects and business analysts to determine functionalities.
 -          Design and develop logical and physical data models that meet application requirements.
 -          Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code
 -          Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate and address these issues.
 -          Create technical documentations for all aspects.
 -          Assist and support other team members
 -          Drive team members to keep up with projects deadlines 
 Technical Skills - In Detail
 (Essential Skills) 
 Strong C# and .Net. , SQL along with Investment banking experience, trades
 Technical Skills
 (Desired Skills) 
 Investment banking knowledge/experience is must. Understanding of trades. Agile/Scrum exp.
 - Grid Technology (IBM Symphony)
                 - Risk computation & Processing
                 - Past experience with in-bank risk systems
 Experience Level 
 8 years plus
 Interview Process 
 1. One interview by delivery team.
 2. Post success of this, 1st round will be a Phone Screening by customer (Developers from client's team will take the interview)
 3. 2nd round will be in-person / VC round (In-person is preferred due to some bad experiences; so please prefer local candidates, or ones who can travel for interview at vendor cost)


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
